lock.description: Locks a layer of an agentic project's container workspace, or a workflow project's worker

image.description: Builds a layer of an agentic project's image chain

serve.description: Serves an agent's image locally, beside DynamoDB Local, until stopped

bundle-workflows.description: Bundles a workflow project's workflows, for its worker

bundle-worker.description: Bundles a workflow project's worker, and stages its image's build context

temporal-server.description: Starts the local Temporal server every project shares, if it is not running, and registers TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE on it; or stops it
